findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "physical-security" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: physical-security_door-access-pattern-detect · Public sink: physical-security_sensor-event-anomaly-detect, physical-security_door-access-pattern-detect, physical-security_access-tailgating-signal-detect, physical-security_perimeter-breach-signal-detect, physical-security_camera-tampering-signal-detect, physical-security_alarm-correlation-analyze, physical-security_iot-device-behavior-analyze, physical-security_building-security-timeline · Destructive: physical-security_sensor-event-anomaly-detect, physical-security_door-access-pattern-detect, physical-security_access-tailgating-signal-detect, physical-security_perimeter-breach-signal-detect, physical-security_camera-tampering-signal-detect, physical-security_alarm-correlation-analyze, physical-security_iot-device-behavior-analyze, physical-security_building-security-timeline.
findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
